plugin.name: Law Firm Management
plugin.description: Case intake & approval, regulatory-grade conflict-of-interest checks with collaborative clearance, billing & invoice ledger (manual reconciliation and Kingdee/Yonyou integration), and lawyer workload & executive dashboard.
expense.formHint: Court fees, expert fees, travel and similar costs are not legal fees. The client pays them separately, so they are kept apart from the legal fees under Invoicing & Fee Collection. Under China's Measures for the Administration of Lawyers' Service Fees, settlement must include a list of costs paid on the client's behalf with valid vouchers; the client may refuse any part without a valid voucher. This ledger is stored on this device.
expense.matterPlaceholder: e.g. Lanhai Optoelectronics v. Huaxing Semiconductor
expense.voucherPlaceholder: e.g. Court receipt No.0012345; leave blank if none
expense.needAmount: Enter an amount greater than 0 with at most two decimals.
expense.quota: Local plugin storage is full (64 KB). Delete older settled entries first.
Law firm overview (read-only): intake/matter status, KPIs and pending conflict clearances; optional project or keyword filter.
tool.lawfirm_management_conflict_check.d: Conflict-of-interest check (read-only, nothing is saved): compares a client and counterparty against existing matters.
tool.lawfirm_management_fee_ledger.desc: Read the fee ledger (read-only): invoices, collections, receivables and collection rate; filter by project or keyword.
